verdict.rationale: Devin is operated mainly through natural-language requests. Its docs describe asking it to tackle tickets, implement features and fix bugs, and starting sessions by tagging it in Slack or Teams conversations. The CLI's Adaptive router analyzes the user's prompt to pick a model, and the web app accepts delegated tasks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language command interface itself, since the community items concern output quality rather than how the product is operated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
Tag Devin on Slack or Teams: Start sessions directly from conversations about bugs, feature requests, or questions.
Adaptive analyzes your prompt and routes it to the model that will deliver the best result.
Delegating a more complex task via the web application
